== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Moonfall is a dark gray scout frigate designed for rapid travel during long subspace journeys. Its physical structure resembles a scorpion with an elevated tail, featuring forward-facing cannons located near its central body. While the vessel is equipped with [[plasma cannons]] and a magical payload [[launcher construct|launcher]], it lacks the durability to withstand heavy military combat, as evidenced by its shields being unable to absorb significant firepower. The ship utilizes an artificial intelligence for navigation and can carry approximately forty students in a cramped interior. During flight, the vessel is capable of atmospheric reentry and can be piloted manually or via its onboard AI.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Moonfall is a scorpion-shaped scout frigate owned by the narrator and piloted by [[Varic Vallenar]]. Designed for speed during long [[Subspace]] runs, this starship is equipped with [[plasma cannons]] and previously crashed into the [[Iron Hive]]. As a ship's computer, Moonfall communicates through speakers to provide internal diagnostics, announcements, and navigational inquiries to the Captain. During the events of the journey, the vessel's environment even resulted in the destruction of the protagonist's clothing.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Moonfall’s smooth voice interrupted my thoughts. “Awaiting navigational data. Where would you like to go, Captain?”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c3" />}}

* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|I briefly cut off my incantation to say, “That’s my ship! They didn’t blow it up.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c16" />}}
